summary: The comparator has strong ID and invariant-field checks, but it is circular on the central target assignment and can certify target records lacking model output without testing the promised Ancestry fallback. Most importantly, derive the expected target flag independently from the canonical labeled data and split target checks by model availability before treating “COMPARE PASSED” as evidence that the MLP input is correct.

findings.title: The comparator reuses the builder's target flag, so a wrong target partition still passes
findings.what_the_code_does: The builder and comparator both execute `merge 1:1 id using ...tgt_flag1940.dta`, assign `tgt = 0 if _merge==1`, and use `tgt`/`!tgt` to decide which fields should remain modeled or revert to Ancestry. The comparator therefore checks consistency with the same mutable flag used to construct the output, rather than independently checking the canonical target definition `!(namefrst==namefrst_fs & namelast==namelast_fs)`.
findings.why_it_matters: A stale, incomplete, or incorrectly constructed flag can apply model names to the wrong records and change target-only linkage results, yet every comparison can still be zero and the script can print `COMPARE PASSED`.
findings.how_to_check: Recompute `expected_tgt = !(namefrst==namefrst_fs & namelast==namelast_fs)` from `census1940_all_labeled_data.dta`, merge it 1:1 with `tgt_flag1940.dta`, and run `tab expected_tgt _merge, missing` plus `assert tgt==1 if _merge==3`; then classify old/new field changes using `expected_tgt`, not the stored flag.
findings.suggested_fix: Build an independent target tempfile from the canonical labeled data inside the comparator and use it for all assertions. Also validate the stored flag against that tempfile, including completeness, uniqueness, `tgt==1`, and missing values.

findings.title: Target records without model output are never checked against the promised Ancestry fallback
findings.what_the_code_does: For every target, the comparator only counts `tgt & v != o_v`, requiring the new `_true_cleaned` fields to equal the old `_true_cleaned` fields. The Ancestry comparison is restricted to `!tgt`. Consequently, targets with `name_true_cleaned_exists==0` are not checked against `o_namefrst`, `o_namelast`, and `o_mi`, despite the builder documenting “Ancestry's where the model gave none.” Upstream, the fallback path loads already-cleaned names without `mi` and runs `abeclean` again.
findings.why_it_matters: A target record with no model transcription can retain a blank middle initial or altered fallback name from the old `_true_cleaned` construction and still pass. Those fields enter MLP linkage and can change link assignments and downstream validation rates.
findings.how_to_check: After the old/new/flag merge, run `count if tgt & o_name_true_cleaned_exists==0 & !(o_namefrst_true_cleaned==o_namefrst & o_namelast_true_cleaned==o_namelast & o_mi_true_cleaned==o_mi)` and repeat field by field to identify which fallback values differ.
findings.suggested_fix: For targets with usable model output, require equality to the old model fields. For targets with `name_true_cleaned_exists==0`, require all three new fields to equal the Ancestry fields and require the existence flag to remain zero; make the builder apply the same fallback explicitly.

findings.title: The validation depends on an unmanifested manually archived baseline
findings.what_the_code_does: The comparator reads `$REP_F/enum_date/DATA/INTERMEDIATE/for_mlp_original/for_mlp1940.dta`, described only as an original received back and left unmodified. That file is not among the frozen inputs hashed by `hash_inputs.py`, and neither the export nor comparator is called by the machine-A master.
findings.why_it_matters: A replicator cannot establish which exact file was sent to or returned from IPUMS, reproduce the comparison, or distinguish the intended baseline from a later manual copy. The check's pass result therefore lacks durable provenance.
findings.how_to_check: Run `rg -n "for_mlp_original|compare_for_mlp_tgt|for_mlp1940_tgt" replication MATCHING LINKAGE`; then compare SHA-256 hashes of the archived old file and outgoing new file against the tracked input manifest or another tracked submission record.
findings.suggested_fix: Record SHA-256 hashes, sizes, dates, and submission identifiers for both outbound files in a tracked manifest; document the manual IPUMS step and add a driver that invokes the builder and comparator in order.

verified_clean.item: Old and new record universes and ID uniqueness are strictly checked.
verified_clean.evidence: Both inputs receive `isid histid`, and the 1:1 merge must satisfy `_merge==3` for every row at MATCHING/compare_for_mlp_tgt.do:28-44.

verified_clean.item: Invariant demographic and Ancestry fields are compared exactly on every record.
verified_clean.evidence: The loop checks `age sex bpl namefrst namelast mi` and accumulates every nonzero difference at MATCHING/compare_for_mlp_tgt.do:53-59.

verified_clean.item: Non-target fallback comparisons do not inflate an agreement statistic through empty strings.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/compare_for_mlp_tgt.do:66-72 uses equality only to test exact file identity for all three fields and separately requires `name_true_cleaned_exists==0`; it does not interpret equality as transcription accuracy.

verified_clean.item: The untracked `_run_*.do` files are generated runner wrappers rather than independent analysis code.
verified_clean.evidence: Their two-line structure matches the template created at replication/Run-Stata.ps1:30-38, whose `RUN-STATA-RC` marker is explicitly parsed at replication/Run-Stata.ps1:55-60.

verified_clean.item: No regression, causal inference, or agreement-as-accuracy calculation was introduced.
verified_clean.evidence: The substantive change is an exact-output diagnostic consisting of loads, 1:1 merges, counts, and assertions at MATCHING/compare_for_mlp_tgt.do:17-82.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so manuscript claims could not be checked against the code.
The external DTA inputs were not readable for this review and the Stata pipeline was not run; current discrepancy counts and whether the comparator completes successfully could not be established.
The IPUMS/HLINK submission process and returned files are external to the repository, so their exact versions and settings could not be independently verified.
